name: clean-highway
about: A plain white conventional tractor and dry van on a prairie highway at dusk, truck in the upper half, grass under the text band.

reference.label: white conventional sleeper tractor, front three-quarter

truth.how: Generated clean: no text, no logo, conventional tractor-trailer like the reference, nothing in the band.

no_glyphs.reason: The trailer sides, cab doors and road are plain, with no letters, numbers, signs or readable plates. The only mark on the front is the grille area, which has no text on it.

no_foreign_logos.reason: The trailer, cab and surroundings are blank white or natural scenery. There is no company name, emblem or anything like ACME Logistics.

equipment_matches_reference.reason: Image 1 shows a white long-nose conventional sleeper tractor pulling a trailer. That is the same type as the white conventional sleeper tractor in image 2.

no_malformed_people_or_vehicles.reason: The tractor has a steer axle and tandem drive axles, and the trailer has a rear tandem. Wheels, cab, fairings and trailer all look whole and plausible, with no merged or duplicated parts.

people_policy_met.reason: No person appears anywhere. The cab windshield and side window look dark and empty, and nobody is on the road or in the field.

safe_zone_clear.reason: Image 3 holds only grass and a small strip of road shoulder with its white edge line in the top-left. No part of a vehicle or person is in it.
